title: Rosemary Beach: Bluebird Cottage in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Bluebird Cottage in Rosemary Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Nestled in the heart of Rosemary Beach, the Bluebird Cottage epitomizes effortless elegance. This 4-bedroom, 4-bath retreat is designed for multigenerational families seeking both serenity and style.

The open concept living space on the first level sets the tone for gatherings, featuring a spacious lounge with a 4K TV, Sonos surround sound, and Apple TV for evenings of entertainment. Culinary delights await in the oversized kitchen, adorned with stainless steel appliances, granite counters, and a generous island. Dine indoors at the island seating, breakfast table, or formal dining area for 8, or take your meals al fresco on the covered porch, beneath the trees, and indulge in the beauty of an outdoor dining area.

A relaxed, but sophisticated, King guest bedroom with a full bath completes the ground floor. Ascend to the second level to discover two King Master suites, each boasting private sitting areas, baths, and adjoining patios-a perfect blend of seclusion and romance. A charming kids' room with built-in bunk beds and a private bath adds a playful touch. With 4 bikes included in your rental, explore the family-friendly enclave on foot or wheels, reaching Rosemary Beach community pools, the beach, eateries, and shops effortlessly.

Two parking spots at the back of property.

PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT MINIMUM SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK & SUMMER
